title: Finiteness of planar central configurations of five bodies for all positive masses: On Smale's sixth problem
summary: We prove that for every choice of five positive masses the planar five-body problem has only finitely many central configurations up to rotation, translation and scaling. This answers Smale's sixth problem for five bodies. Albouy and Kaloshin proved the statement for all masses outside a closed algebraic subset of codimension two of the mass space. We keep their classification of singular sequences and combine local boundary analysis with a global argument on an algebraic curve.
